title: After a revoked grant, three older save attempts still repeat a failed cloud save with no throttle: the web's page-hide save (flushRoadmapStoreSync, every time the tab hides or closes), the iPhone's foreground save (cloudVisible's flushSync, every return to the app), and the iPhone's re-read, which retries a failed save first (cloud.ts reread's flushSync: every poll tick, Sync now, return, and the catch-up after the network comes back). Each one is reported: a cloud save's report never sets repeat (only the device tier names a refusal kind), so the web sends one 'Cloud sync failed' Sentry event per hide and the iPhone one 'failed' notice per attempt
evidence: Lead A1 step e (owner D2, 2026-11-13): the new triggers (online, focus) never retry after a refused grant; these two were left as they were. widget-src/src/components/HealthTool.tsx stage() on visibilitychange/pagehide; ios/engine/cloud.ts cloudVisible() and reread(); packages/health-core/src/record-host.ts reportSaveFailure (repeat only on the device tier); widget-src/src/storage/web-record-host.ts report (Sentry unless repeat)
